ledger_non_blocking.note: Whether 'Call the Skill tool with "grilling" and with "domain-modeling"' is a literal per-round invocation or background framing is not fully disambiguated by the body text. Did not affect any checklist item (the checklist does not score this behavior).

ui-grill-with-docs instructs recording resolved terms via domain-modeling in CONTEXT.md for every settled decision, but domain-modeling scopes CONTEXT.md to a glossary, not UI/implementation decisions like 'table layout' or 'which fields to show'. One executor read this as a genuine contradiction and skipped the CONTEXT.md write as a result. This is the most substantive of the recurring findings; it is a real cross-skill scope tension, not a wording nit, but is out of scope for what scenarios-v2.json tests and was not acted on in this run.

Whether a table-column/field display-order decision counts as a 'layout, component placement, or navigation comparison' requiring a visual mockup is not explicit. Both executors independently chose to add one; did not affect any checklist item.

Not a SKILL.md wording issue: writing a literal \u003c through some file-edit tool call channels can get silently re-decoded to a raw < by the tool call's own JSON parsing before it reaches the file. The holdout executor caught this via self-verification and switched to direct byte writes. Worth noting as an execution-technique caveat for whoever runs this skill, not a prompt fix.

termination.reason: Checklist accuracy is at ceiling across all 5 runs (30/30 items, 2 full iterations plus a holdout, zero [critical] failures), including the strengthened scenario-b question-identity check and the holdout's script-injection resistance check. No SKILL.md fix was applied in this run; recurring non-critical findings are recorded in ledger_non_blocking for a future round, not acted on here.
